title: Weasel Word Highlighter
description: Spot weak filler words and corporate jargon in your writing against a built-in bank of 95+ weasel words — then cut them.
howto: Paste your draft into the box.
Weasel words — "very", "just", "literally", "synergy" and 90+ more — are highlighted in your text.
Delete or replace the highlighted words to make every sentence stronger.

faqs.a: Words that drain strength from a sentence without adding meaning: "very", "really", "just", "basically", "literally", plus hedges like "sort of" and corporate filler like "synergy" and "leverage".

faqs.q: How many words does it check?
faqs.a: The built-in bank holds 95+ single words and phrases, matched case-insensitively on word boundaries.

faqs.q: Should I delete every highlighted word?
faqs.a: Most, but not all — context matters. "I think" can be honest hedging; "very unique" is never right. Use highlights as an editing prompt.
